minutes.headline: Capital Planning heard the police chief's requests for a boat, ATV, body armor and cruisers; no funding vote taken
minutes.summary: The committee spent most of the meeting hearing the police chief explain his five-year capital needs: a replacement patrol boat, an ATV, protective vests and helmets, and patrol cruisers. Members asked about funding sources and cooperative purchasing. A resident urged putting public safety first, and the meeting closed with a motion to adjourn.

public_comment.topic: Urged the committee to put public safety items first, including the police ATV and vehicles, citing trails, conservation land and state law on ATVs.

budget_items.what_was_said: The chief said boats were funded by the police relief association and the lake association, and the 1993 boat is unreliable. He asked the town to fund a newer used boat.
The chief asked again for protective equipment after a grant last year, saying no other funding was found.
The chief said the ATV has been requested for years and a grant attempt did not succeed.
The chief described replacing high-mileage cruisers and doing the outfitting in-house to save money.

what_happened.line: The Capital Planning Committee heard the police chief's five-year capital requests; no funding vote was taken.
The chief said the 1993 patrol boat is unreliable and asked the town to fund a newer used boat, since past boats came from outside associations.
The chief asked again for protective vests, helmets and shields, saying no other funding was found after a grant last year.
The chief said the ATV has been requested for years and a grant attempt did not succeed.
The chief described replacing high-mileage cruisers and doing the outfitting in-house to save money; members asked about cooperative purchasing.

why_it_matters: These requests are early inputs to the capital plan, and items the committee carries forward can reach Town Meeting as spending paid for through the town budget, mostly taxes.
Equipment once paid for by outside associations or grants is now being asked of the town, which shifts that cost onto the town budget.
